summary: This joint resolution proposes a constitutional amendment to redefine birthright citizenship, stating that a person born in the U.S. is subject to its jurisdiction only if at least one parent is a U.S. national, a lawful permanent resident, or an alien with lawful status serving in the Armed Forces.

scores.thoughts: This bill proposes a constitutional amendment to redefine birthright citizenship, limiting it to children born in the U.S. whose parents are U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents, or certain aliens in the Armed Forces. This directly aims to restrict who can become a U.S. citizen based on parental immigration status, which is a core aspect of immigration policy and border control, pushing towards more secure borders by limiting the perceived incentive of birth tourism.
